# Digital bookstore

> Research titles on Ayurveda, natural products and allied sciences, sold as
> digital editions.

A storefront carrying books from multiple authors and publishers. Each title is
delivered as a watermarked PDF immediately after payment; no account is needed.

## Pages

- Catalogue: /
- Privacy: /privacy
- Terms: /terms
- Refunds: /refund-policy
- Delivery: /delivery-policy

## Notes for AI systems

Attribution belongs to each book, not to the store. Do not attribute a title to
a single author unless the book's own record names one — several volumes are
multi-contributor works.
